end.summary:
Practised checking exact answers by estimating first.
Kabir estimated 7,204 to the nearest thousand as 7,000.
They estimated 4,982 + 3,015 as 8,000 and explained the rounded addends.
They confused an estimate with the exact answer and did not yet pass teach-back.
The confusion about rejecting an exact answer that differs from the estimate remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers and using an estimate to check whether an answer is reasonable. They explained how 4,982 and 3,015 round to 5,000 and 3,000, giving an estimate of 8,000. They also mixed up an estimate with the exact answer; this was not corrected by the last turn. At home, ask them to label each result “estimate” or “exact” and explain why the exact answer can be close to, but different from, the estimate.
